 Mr. Rajesh Upadhyay

 Mr. Subhadip Roy
 ......For the respdt. nos. 2 to 6
 Mr. Sabyasachi Chowdhury
 Ms. Sanchari Chakraborty
 ......For the respdt. nos. 7 & 8

The respondents 7 & 8 are manufacturers of glucose
biscuits.

Contracts were entered into by and between the petitioners for purchase of biscuits from the said respondents 7 & 8, pursuant whereto the biscuits purchased by the petitioners were exported to Sierra Leone, West Africa.

According to the petitioners, the cartons of biscuits exported by them upon testing by the Government of Sierra Leone, Ministry of Health & Sanitation,
Environmental Health Division were found to contain biscuits that had expired long back and, thus,
unfit for human consumption.

This writ petition dated 24th August, 2015 has been presented by the petitioners seeking a direction on the official respondents (officials of the Food, Safety & Standards Authority of India) to enforce the provisions of the Food, Safety & Standards Act, 2006 by initiating prosecution against the respondents 7 & 8.

entities.text: Food, Safety & Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In my view, the petitioners have presented this writ petition for oblique motives and it is not a bona fide litigation.
If at all the respondents 7 & 8 had passed off expired biscuits, it was the duty of the petitioners to have made appropriate inspection before purchasing the same.
It is also admitted at the bar that a civil suit has been instituted claiming diverse relief and the petitioners shall be at liberty to press their claim in the suit.
I find no reason to entertain the writ petition.
The same stands dismissed, without costs.

opennyai_summary.facts:
Contracts were entered into by and between the petitioners for purchase of biscuits from the said respondents 7 & 8, pursuant whereto the biscuits purchased by the petitioners were exported to Sierra Leone, West Africa.
According to the petitioners, the cartons of biscuits exported by them upon testing by the Government of Sierra Leone, Ministry of Health & Sanitation,
Environmental Health Division were found to contain biscuits that had expired long back and, thus,
unfit for human consumption.
In my view, the petitioners have presented this writ petition for oblique motives and it is not a bona fide litigation.
If at all the respondents 7 & 8 had passed off expired biscuits, it was the duty of the petitioners to have made appropriate inspection before purchasing the same.
Their claim sounds in damages.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: It is also admitted at the bar that a civil suit has been instituted claiming diverse relief and the petitioners shall be at liberty to press their claim in the suit.
opennyai_summary.decision:
I find no reason to entertain the writ petition.
The same stands dismissed, without costs.
However, any observation made herein shall not influence the trial judge who is in seisin of the suit instituted by the petitioners.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the parties as expeditiously as possible.
